# RIVET EV Infrastructure Intelligence commercial intent cluster

Public ID: rivet-site-underwriting-v1
Problem: A property owner, fleet, charging developer, broker, installer or investor needs address-specific EV infrastructure diligence that keeps public facts, observed evidence, modeled assumptions and unresolved engineering questions separate.
Pricing: $299 Preliminary Site Opportunity Report; $750 Full Site Opportunity Report.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready_human_confirmation
Human review: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=rivet-site-underwriting-v1
Capability contract: /chum/capabilities/rivet-site-underwriting-v1/

- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout requires explicit human confirmation where supported.
- Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
